scope: Annual research only: national, economic activity (NACE Rev.2), sex, ownership, business sector, region and median earnings; no quarterly data, real wages, serving or UI integration

source_footnotes.text: *Currency - before 1993 -Rouble; 1993 - Coupon; 1994 - Thousand Coupon; since 1995 - Lari.
*The significant decrease of earnings in Financial Intermediation sector can be explained by methodological changes, which concerns coverage of units contained in the sector
*The significant decrease of earnings in Financial Intermediation sector can be explained by methodological changes, which concerns coverage of units contained in the sector
* - The reduction of the average monthly earnings in the fishing section in 2009 can be explained by the fact that one of the enterprises temporarily ceased functioning in the given period.
** - In 2007 one large enterprise was established as a result of the merger of a few smaller size businesses. In this new merger the number of employees was cut and the average earnings went up.
*** - From 2009 one of the enterprises changed its main profile, which resulted in the increase of the average earnings.
**** - In 2009 one of the large enterprises - where the average earnings was high - ceased its activities.
***** - In 2010 one of the large enterprises changed its ownership type, which resulted in the decreases of the average earnings.
* Some enterprise and organizations are represented by the location of the head office
Source: LEPL Revenue Service of the Ministry of Finance of Georgia.

limitations: Average earnings are gross monthly earnings per paid employee, with part-time employees converted to full-time equivalents; they exclude self-employed people.
The median is calculated from Revenue Service records per employee (2018 onward); it is not from the enterprise survey and is published in whole lari.

Primary national values start in 1995 with the lari; 1970-1994 headline values are retained as legacy observations, in roubles before 1993, coupons in 1993 and thousand coupons in 1994. The preserved survey metadata documents coverage from 1998, so 1995-1997 rest on the headline workbook alone.
Activity breakdowns use NACE Rev.2 from 2014; NACE Rev.1.1 values for 1998-2019 are retained as legacy observations and must not be joined to NACE Rev.2 sections.
Since 2006 the business sector and the non-business and financial sector are surveyed separately.
Regional values place some enterprises at their head office location.
Cells marked as unavailable in the source are listed in unavailable-cells.csv; none is filled.
Source cells keep more decimals than the published one-decimal values; those decimals are retained for reconciliation only.
